_doc: Per-repo build overrides for build_modules.py, keyed by GitHub repo. script: run this file instead of scripts/build.sh. args/env: passed to it. commands: shell lines run in the repo root instead of any script. pre_commands: shell lines run before the script (host-side steps a script skips when it believes it is inside its container). prebuild_docker: [Dockerfile, context] run once through the docker emulator so dependencies it builds land in the shared sysroot; prebuild_product: sysroot path proving that happened. cflags: extra compiler flags (e.g. a switch the module's own sources document). package: {module_id: {dest_name: repo_path}} to assemble dist/<id>/ when a script leaves outputs elsewhere. requires: host tools needed (reported when missing). skip: reason there is nothing to build. note: free text.

filliformes/structor-move.note: vendored pffft.c has an operator-precedence bug in pffft_zreorder: `(v4sf *) out + N / 2` instead of `(v4sf *)(out + N / 2)`; on any SIMD path (NEON on Move too, SSE, Apple NEON) the ordered transform writes past its output buffer. The file's own PFFFT_SIMD_DISABLE switch selects the scalar path, where v4sf is float and the expression is correct. See docs/UPSTREAM_ISSUES.md #6.
